'''Shades''' are [[monsters]] that can be encountered in [[Temple Trekking]] while travelling along the hard route, which attempt to break into the houses of the three unafflicted people in [[Mort'ton]]. On occasion they have also been known to leave their catacombs to attack [[Temple Trekking|trekkers]] and [[Burgh de Rott Ramble|ramblers]] in the town above their dark burial place.
